text: Kyoto and Osaka with my two kids and partner, 2026-12-20 to 2026-12-24, 4 people
draft:
I'll load the city skills and search hotels for both cities.# Draft itinerary — Kyoto & Osaka with two kids (20–24 Dec 2026)

**Overview**: Kyoto 2 nights → Osaka 2 nights → leave from Kansai Airport (KIX) | 1 hotel change | light · standard · standard · standard · light

**Before you go**
- Book any timed-entry or reservation-only places a few weeks ahead (please check each site's current rules).
- Get IC cards (ICOCA/Suica) for the four of you at KIX — works on trains, subways and buses in both cities.
- On 22 Dec, forward the big suitcases from the Kyoto hotel to the Osaka hotel by takkyubin (arrange the evening before) and travel light.
- Winter in Kansai is cold and dry; pack layers and comfortable shoes for temple steps and the deer park.
- Compare a JR Pass against your actual legs before buying — for this route it may not pay off (please check current prices).

**Day 1 | Arrival · Kyoto Station area (light)**
- 14:00 KIX → JR Haruka to Kyoto Station, approx. 75 min, no transfer
- 15:30 Check in, rest and snack
- 17:00 Short walk around Kyoto Station: illuminated station building and rooftop view — easy first evening with kids
- 18:30 Dinner near the hotel, early night
- Tonight: Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo (京都八条都酒店)

**Day 2 | Higashiyama · Kiyomizu-dera and Gion (standard)**
- 08:30 Bus or taxi to Kiyomizu-dera, approx. 15 min — early morning is far calmer
- 09:00 Kiyomizu-dera, then walk downhill through Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka, approx. 20 min
- 12:00 Lunch in Higashiyama
- 13:30 Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park, walk approx. 10 min
- 15:30 Rest at the hotel or a café
- 17:00 Gion in the evening: lantern-lit streets, fewer people than midday
- 18:30 Dinner in Pontocho / Kawaramachi (Keihan line 1 stop, approx. 5 min)
- Alternatives: if rain, Kyoto National Museum or the Nishiki Market arcade instead of the Sannenzaka walk; if tired, drop Maruyama Park
- Tonight: Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo (京都八条都酒店)

**Day 3 | Nara day trip, then move to Osaka (standard)**
- 08:30 Kintetsu Kyoto → Kintetsu-Nara, approx. 45 min, no transfer (limited express faster)
- 09:30 Nara Park: Kofuku-ji, then Todai-ji Great Buddha, walk approx. 15 min — keep snacks away from the deer with small children
- 12:00 Lunch in Naramachi
- 13:30 Kasuga Taisha, walk approx. 20 min (hilly; take it slowly)
- 15:00 Kintetsu-Nara → Osaka-Namba, approx. 40 min, no transfer
- 16:30 Check in to the Osaka hotel, rest
- 18:00 Dotonbori evening walk and street food, walk approx. 10 min from Namba
- Alternatives: if rain, Nara National Museum and the Great Buddha Hall (both indoors) instead of Kasuga Taisha; if tired, drop Naramachi and go straight to Osaka
- Tonight: Sotetsu Grand Fresa Osaka Namba (相铁Grand Fresa 大阪难波酒店)

**Day 4 | Osaka · castle and bay area (standard)**
- 09:00 Subway to Osaka Castle Park, approx. 20 min, 1 transfer — park and castle exterior, kids can run
- 11:30 Lunch near the park
- 13:00 Subway to Osakako, approx. 25 min, 1 transfer
- 13:30 Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan, approx. 2–3 h — indoor and warm, good for a winter afternoon
- 17:00 Back to Namba, rest
- 18:30 Dinner in Shinsaibashi; winter illuminations along Midosuji in the evening
- Alternatives: if rain, swap the castle park for the Osaka Museum of History (indoor) and keep the aquarium; if tired, drop the illuminations walk
- Tonight: Sotetsu Grand Fresa Osaka Namba (相铁Grand Fresa 大阪难波酒店)

**Day 5 | Departure (light)**
- 09:00 Breakfast and souvenirs near Namba only
- 10:30 Nankai rapi:t Namba → KIX, approx. 40 min, no transfer; leave plenty of time for check-in
- Please check train times and your airline's check-in deadline before going.

Hotel prices shown are per night from live search results and may change — please confirm when booking.
